_comment: Goal-oriented advisory workflows. Listing, showing, and recommending never enables or invokes a capability.

workflows.title: Understand an unfamiliar repository
workflows.summary: Orient by bounded file/line evidence, then expand to architecture only when needed.

steps.outcome: Entry points, relevant files, and bounded evidence.
Cross-file call paths or architecture map only when initial evidence is insufficient.

workflows.title: Implement a scoped feature
workflows.summary: Plan/spec according to tier, implement the agreed delta, test, and review.

steps.outcome: Tier-appropriate scope and evidence paths.
Smallest defensible implementation.
Behavioral evidence and regression review.

workflows.title: Diagnose and fix a failure
workflows.summary: Reproduce, isolate the root cause, authorize the fix, and close with regression evidence.

steps.outcome: Evidence-backed root cause without speculative edits.
Human confirms that implementation is in scope.
Minimal fix, regression test, and reusable note when warranted.

workflows.title: Perform a read-only security audit
workflows.summary: Bound the threat model, collect verified findings, and stop before remediation.

steps.outcome: Assets, actors, inputs, boundaries, and inspected scope.
Verified findings separated from defense-in-depth improvements.

workflows.title: Remediate approved security findings
workflows.summary: Convert verified findings into explicitly selected fixes, closure tests, and independent re-review.

steps.outcome: Stable finding IDs with evidence and closure tests.
Human selects exact finding IDs and separately authorizes any dependency, schema, auth, commit, push, or publication change.
Smallest approved fixes without weakening the primary boundary.
Closure tests, affected suite, and independent re-review.

workflows.title: Prepare a release
workflows.summary: Validate inventory, dependencies, security, artifacts, and publication evidence before immutable actions.

steps.outcome: Versioned release plan and bounded risk evidence.
Tests, inventory, artifact, and documentation evidence.
Separate approval before tag, push, release, package publication, or visibility change.

workflows.title: Plan and execute a migration
workflows.summary: Map dependencies, specify compatibility and rollback, then gate execution and verification.

steps.outcome: Affected boundaries, compatibility, data, and rollback plan.
Phase boundaries and observable migration gates.
Human authorizes the exact migration phase.
Bounded migration with rollback and regression evidence.
